gameName: Heroes of Might and Magic III: The Board Game

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Heroes of Might and Magic III: The Board Game rulebook (Archon Studio)

steps.text: Pick a {m} scenario from the Mission Book
steps.note: Tutorial: Brave New World (Mission Book p.7)

steps.text: Choose a faction (core: Castle, Dungeon, Necropolis); on a tie the highest Resource die roll picks first
Choose one of your faction's Heroes as your Main Hero; a faction cube on level 1 of the Hero card
Take your faction's Hero card, 2 Hero models, 7 Town Building tiles, Town board, 7 Unit cards, 3 Specialty cards and Ability card for your Hero, 20 cubes, Build, Population and Spell Book tokens
Lay out the Map tiles for your player count as the Mission Book shows
Town board in front of you, Building tiles beside it; place the buildings the scenario starts with
Starting income from the scenario on the income tracker; Population, Build and Spell Book tokens on their spots
Resource tokens in piles; take the scenario's starting resources next to your Hero card
All other tokens in piles within reach
Statistic cards in 4 piles (Attack, Defense, Power, Knowledge); take the numbers shown on your Hero card as your starting deck
Add Magic Arrow: 1 copy for a Might hero, 2 for a Magic hero
Add your Hero's Ability card and Level 1 Specialty card; shuffle the deck facedown by your Hero card
Ability, Artifact and Spell cards in 3 facedown decks; flip the top card of each beside it as its discard pile
Choose the starting difficulty and take its Starting Bonus(es)
Neutral Units in 4 shuffled decks by tier (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Azure), room for discards
Combat board next to the Map; set aside the starting units the scenario gives you
Round tracker by the Map with a black cube on 1; shuffle the Astrologers Proclaim cards facedown beside it
Rotate your Starting tile as you like; Hero model on the field with the Town
Rounds alternate: Resource round (collect income), then Astrologers' round (draw a Proclaim card)
Advance the black cube on the Round tracker after every player's turn
Fastest to list 5 Neutral units from HoMM III goes first (or highest Attack die roll)
